_comment: Starter template for local API credentials. Copy this file to `api_keys.local.json` (git-ignored) and fill in YOUR OWN endpoints and keys. Never commit real values. Entries are matched in order via `provider_root_contains`. Optional `min_balance_usd` skips keys whose prepaid balance is below the threshold (requires the endpoint to expose a usage route; enable it per host with the EPM_BALANCE_CHECK_HOSTS env var). `settings_override` can override model selection locally without touching common.json.
